author: Second Wind
description:
Marty's latest video essay on Pokémon Pokopia. What started off as a cute spinoff of the world’s biggest media franchise suddenly coalesced into something more than just a cozy life sim, creative outlet, or fun sandbox to zone out in. It slowly dawned on him that Pokémon Pokopia is a legitimate Game of the Year contender and something that has taken over his life in the best possible way.
